copyContract: For each selected image descriptor assets/materials/<id>.jpg, copy only its matching data/upstream/expansion12-materials/previews/<id>.jpg

censusUnit: Official public posts; news/non-material posts, unavailable originals and oversized maps remain in the attempted denominator and are not counted as assets
originalChannelPolicy: One actual author-linked BaseColor/Diffuse/Albedo map per independent material; observed legacy *_COLOR maps are accepted only with companion PBR channel names proving the color-map identity. Other channels/resolutions/crops/frames do not add assets.
